review_candidates.title: BESS Senior Asset Manager - Germany
review_candidates.description: Location: Hamburg or remote in Germany Travel: Regular travel across Germany, with occasional European travel Type: Full-time BW ESS is looking for a Senior BESS Asset Manager for Germany to take ownership of the performance, commercial optimisation, and operational management of our German battery energy storage assets. This role is suited to someone with a blend of technical and commercial experience: a person who understands how utility-scale battery or power assets perform operationally, how they generate value in energy markets, and how to manage contracts, data, counterparties, and regulatory requirements across the full asset lifecycle. We are especially interested in candidates with experience in utility-scale BESS, renewables, grid infrastructure, power markets, or energy asset management, ideally with exposure to the German energy market. About BW ESS BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain, Sweden and France. It has more than 1.8GWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with ~12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts. Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle. To find out more, visit: https://bw-ess.com/ The Role As BESS Asset Manager, you will be responsible for the operational and commercial performance of utility-scale battery assets in the German market, with potential exposure to a wider European portfolio. You will work across asset performance, route-to-market optimisation, contract management, budgeting, warranty management, regulatory compliance, and site integration. You will collaborate closely with German and international colleagues, RTM providers, optimisers, OEMs, O&M contractors, EPCs, TSOs/DSOs, and other market counterparties. The role sits at the intersection of technical asset management, commercial optimisation, energy markets, and regulation. You will help ensure BW ESS’s German portfolio is positioned to perform across products such as FCR, aFRR, mFRR, intraday and day-ahead markets, and other relevant flexibility or capacity mechanisms. Key Responsibilities Manage and monitor the performance, availability, degradation, cycle counts, and operational health of utility-scale BESS assets. Analyse SCADA, EMS, and asset data to identify underperformance, diagnose root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with technical teams and service providers. Work with route-to-market providers and optimisers to monitor and improve commercial performance across German balancing and wholesale markets. Support and oversee optimiser, O&M, OEM, EPC, and other service provider contracts, ensuring obligations and KPIs are met. Review invoices, manage budget inputs, support OPEX/CAPEX tracking, and contribute to medium- and long-term cost and revenue forecasting. Maintain warranty registers, monitor warranty periods, coordinate claims, and manage related documentation and stakeholder processes. Support commissioning, control system setup, EMS/software integration, data validation, testing, and handover into operations. Track relevant German and EU regulatory developments, including BNetzA, TSO/DSO requirements, EEX, grid codes, and market rule changes. Experience We’re Looking For We are looking for candidates who can bring both technical credibility and commercial judgement. You should ideally have: Minimum of 3+ years’ experience in utility-scale BESS, renewables, grid infrastructure, power generation, energy asset management, or a closely related field. Experience managing or supporting operational energy assets, ideally in Germany or another European power market. Understanding of battery systems, lithium-ion technology, inverters, BMS, EMS/SCADA, grid connections, and asset performance metrics. Commercial exposure to energy markets, route-to-market arrangements, optimisation, balancing markets, intraday/day-ahead trading, or asset revenue management. Familiarity with German energy market structures, TSOs, DSOs, BNetzA, EEX, grid codes, and ancillary service products would be highly valuable. Experience working with data tools such as PowerBI, SQL, Excel, or similar platforms. Strong contract management, reporting, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and spoken German and English. A degree in electrical engineering, energy systems, or a related technical or commercial discipline would be beneficial, but relevant hands-on experience is equally important. Who This Role Is Best Suited To This role may suit someone currently working as a: BESS Asset Manager Renewable Energy Asset Manager Energy Storage Operations Manager Technical Asset Manager Commercial Asset Manager Optimisation or Route-to-Market Manager Power Markets Analyst with asset exposure Grid or flexibility market specialist Why Join BW ESS? This is an opportunity to join a fast-moving global energy storage owner-operator with a long-term ownership strategy and a growing European portfolio. You will play a key role in the success of BW ESS’s German assets, working across the technical, operational, and commercial dimensions of one of Europe’s most important energy storage markets. If you have the right mix of technical asset knowledge, commercial energy market experience, and German market understanding, we would like to hear from you. BW ESS is committed to building a high-performing, inclusive team and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

review_candidates.description: Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investment? Do you thrive with financial modelling, analytical problem-solving, and translating complex analyses into strategic decisions? Then Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is the perfect place for you. We are currently looking for an Associate or Senior Associate to join our Group Financial Planning & Analysis (“GFP&A”) team. The team The Group Financial Planning & Analysis team is part of CIP Finance and provides key financial analyses and decision support to the CFO, CIP management, and CIP's owners, helping shape balance sheet investment decisions and CIP's strategic direction. Our team consists of three professionals within GFP&A, specializing in financial and portfolio modelling to support group-level financial decision-making at CIP. We work as a closely integrated team, delivering high-quality analyses and recommendations in collaboration with key stakeholders, including the CFO, CIP management, and CIP's owners. Our work supports major business decisions and plays an important role in shaping CIP's long-term growth and strategic direction. The role The ideal candidate combines advanced financial modelling capabilities with solid analytical and problem-solving skills. You will build, develop, and operate complex financial models, assess opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios, and provide actionable insights to support business-critical decisions. Equally important is the ability to communicate complex topics in a clear, concise, and impactful manner through presentations and decision materials tailored to different audiences. You will thrive in a busy environment, balancing multiple priorities while consistently delivering high-quality work. Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:: Develop and maintain complex financial models covering CIP Holding's investments, CIP-managed funds, external investments, and financing structures. Support the CFO and senior management with analysis and decision-making material. Conduct ad hoc analyses of investments and financial structures to assess risks, opportunities, and portfolio impacts under different scenarios. Prepare high-quality financial analyses, presentations, and recommendations for management. Communicate complex financial and quantitative topics clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate across CIP and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously. You We are looking for candidates with a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. The ideal candidate brings 2-4 years of relevant experience from a reputable FP&A, corporate finance, private equity, infrastructure investing, investment banking, or management consulting environment. A demonstrated experience in building, developing, and operating complex financial models and supporting business-critical decisions through thorough analysis is essential. Experience supporting senior management and strategic decision-making in a high-performance environment is considered beneficial. We look for the following in a candidate: Exceptional financial, portfolio, and scenario modelling capabilities. Solid analytical skills, numerical acumen, and attention to detail. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency. Ability to structure complex problems, evaluate opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios. Ability to simplify and translate complex topics into clear, concise, and impactful presentations tailored to different audiences, including senior stakeholders. Comfortable working across multiple workstreams simultaneously, prioritizing effectively, and delivering high-quality results in a busy environment with competing deadlines. Self-motivated, collaborative, and results-oriented mindset. Excellent written and verbal English skills. The process Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email. As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership. Building value that matters Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy. Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture. With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date. CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally. For more information, visit www.cip.com.

review_candidates.title: Linux Devices Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: This role is one of our general tracks. Apply here for all engineering teams at Canonical who work on low-level system technology on autonomous devices across all seniority levels. We hire careful and conscientious engineers who appreciate the challenge of memory, performance, battery and connectivity constrained code that has to work every time in an unreliable and unforgiving world, on x86, ARM or RISC-V silicon. Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices. These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu – desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance. We partner with the world's most prominent silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu on their latest and greatest chips, as well as with major OEMs and ODMs (PC, servers and connected device manufacturers) to ensure that Ubuntu works perfectly on their hardware. But while classic, ‘deb’ based Ubuntu is ideal for developers, it has too much variability for appliance or connected device environments, where you want to know *exactly* what the state of millions or billions of devices might be. So Canonical builds Ubuntu Core, a fully containerised version of Ubuntu that is mathematically precise and rigorously secure. We are working on additional solutions for even smaller devices. We have several teams that focus on open source for embedded environments. We hire outstanding Linux software engineers with a passion for open source, innovation, cutting-edge hardware and software technologies in general. You will be expected to make significant contributions through high-quality design and code, and to develop your technical leadership. These roles include: Ubuntu Core and snapd software development Silicon software and optimisation engineers Kernel driver and hardware enablement engineers Hardware-centric Linux QA Engineers Hardware Certification Engineers Robotics engineers Industrial IoT software engineers Networking software engineers (switching, routing, access and SmartNICs) At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu and Ubuntu Core across the widest range of devices. Location: we have remote roles open in every time zone. What your day will look like Based on the first round of interviews we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit, and conduct second round interviews with those teams. Our engineers: Work with the latest Linux kernel and open source technologies Deliver Ubuntu for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms Integrate and maintain device-oriented software stacks Write high-quality, well-designed software Collaborate proactively with other globally distributed teams Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities Help our customers ship their apps and SDKs on Ubuntu Build device OS images with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server Optimise the Ubuntu kernel and libraries for silicon-specific capabilities Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge Work usually from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for company events What we are looking for in you An Define assurance, evidence and approval requirements for disaster recovery testing and critical or high-risk production changes; assess outcomes, incidents and control gaps; and monitor exceptions, compensating controls, risk acceptances and remediation priorities. Oversee capacity planning and track disaster recovery, Production Assurance and capacity gaps through to closure, using forecasts, dashboards, application reviews, production incidents and failed-change trends to identify systemic risks and drive preventive improvements, with complete and audit-ready plans, approvals and evidence. Align cross-functional stakeholders, including SRE, Business Continuity Management, Technology Risk, Enterprise Architecture, Application Managers, Business Owners and infrastructure teams, on risk priorities, decisions and remediation plans. Lead audit, regulatory and management assurance coordination, while driving continuous improvement and automation of governance, reporting and evidence-management processes. Experience And Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Risk Management, or related fields, backed by significant resilience and disaster recovery experience in complex financial services. Deep knowledge of DR, high-availability architecture, backup and recovery, operational resilience, and multi-layered infrastructure (cloud, virtualization, networks, middleware), complemented by relevant certifications (e.g., CBCP, CISSP, CISM, ITIL) preferred. Strategic thinker with strong communication, stakeholder management, and regulatory compliance skills (such as MAS TRM and BCM) to drive risk-based governance, audit coordination, and continuous improvement. review_candidates.company: The Supreme International Court of Higher Justice
review_candidates.description: Company Description The Supreme International Court of Higher Justice is an international judicial institution established on 12 July 2026 under the Charter of The Universal Human Strategic Board for the Defense of Human Rights. It operates independently from any national governments, public or private interest groups, and any external political influence, with a mandate to investigate and report abuses and crimes against humanity. The Supreme Court focuses on the protection of twelve fundamental human rights and applies international human rights law to safeguard vulnerable individuals in situations such as armed conflict, epidemics, social or famine crises, and natural disasters. It functions as both a judicial and legislative authority, committed to impartiality, fairness, confidentiality, and the protection of all disclosed information under the law. The Supreme Court is composed of twelve magistrates, a defense lawyer, a prosecutor, a secretary general, and an investigating judge, all appointed through a judicial commission. Role description The Supreme Law Officer is a remote role responsible for providing high-level legal oversight and guidance on matters related to international human rights and judicial procedure. His role reviews case files, legal briefs, and investigative reports and contributes to the development of legal recommendations and strategic directives for the Supreme Court. The Supreme Law Officer collaborates with magistrates, prosecutors, defense representatives, and investigators to ensure that litigation, case management, and judicial processes comply with international human rights standards. This role also supports the design and implementation of legal policies and judicial plans that enhance the Supreme Court’s effectiveness and adherence to its founding principles. Regular participation in online hearings, committees, and working groups is expected, with a focus on thorough legal analysis and impartial decision-making. Main qualifications Strong expertise in law and courts, with a deep understanding of international human rights law and judicial procedures. Demonstrated experience in litigation, including case analysis, advocacy, and oversight of complex legal matters. Proficiency in Legal Writing, including drafting opinions, briefs, reports, and policy documents with clarity and precision. Ability to apply management skills to legal initiatives, coordinating timelines, resources, and cross-functional collaboration. Advanced degree in law (e.g., LL.M., J.D., or equivalent) with specialization or substantial experience in international or human rights law. Proven ability to work remotely across diverse cultures and time zones, maintaining confidentiality and ethical standards. Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and decision-making abilities, with a commitment to impartiality and fairness. Prior experience with international courts, tribunals, or human rights organizations is highly beneficial.
